# DSH plugin tools. Generated by packages/deepseek-harness-extension/scripts/interface-listing.mjs; do not edit.
# Run `pnpm interfaces` after changing them. Format: ITEM | ATTRIBUTES | DESCRIPTION
tool wechat_archive_history | opt-in via tools.grants.archive | Stored messages of any chat in this account (archive scope), newest first. Read-only.
tool wechat_archive_history.cursor | string | Opaque page cursor from a previous call.
tool wechat_archive_history.limit | integer, min 1, max 200 | How many messages to return.
tool wechat_archive_history.threadId | string, required, min length 1 | Stored chat to read (any chat in this account).
tool wechat_archive_media | opt-in via tools.grants.archive | Attachment metadata for one stored message anywhere in this account (archive scope). Reports state/contentType/size/checksum; never downloads bytes.
tool wechat_archive_media.messageId | string, required, min length 1 | Stored message ID.
tool wechat_archive_message | opt-in via tools.grants.archive | Read one stored message anywhere in this account (archive scope). Read-only.
tool wechat_archive_message.messageId | string, required, min length 1 | Stored message ID.
tool wechat_archive_search | opt-in via tools.grants.archive | Search stored messages across the whole account, optionally inside one chat (archive scope). Read-only.
tool wechat_archive_search.cursor | string | Opaque page cursor from a previous call.
tool wechat_archive_search.limit | integer, min 1, max 200 | How many matches to return.
tool wechat_archive_search.query | string, required, min length 1 | Text to look for across this account.
tool wechat_archive_search.threadId | string | Restrict the search to one chat.
tool wechat_archive_threads | opt-in via tools.grants.archive | List stored chats across the whole account (archive scope): query by name, page with cursor. Read-only.
tool wechat_archive_threads.cursor | string | Opaque page cursor from a previous call.
tool wechat_archive_threads.limit | integer, min 1, max 200 | How many threads to return.
tool wechat_archive_threads.query | string | Optional title filter for stored threads.
tool wechat_call | opt-in via calls config | Place and manage WeChat voice calls for the configured account. Actions: status (list the calls feature state and live calls), dial (start a direct call to a contact id), hangup (end a call by id, or the current one), conference_start (start a conference inside a group chat with invitee contact ids), invite (add contacts to a live call). Mutating actions require the owner caller (calls.voice.outboundToolAllowFrom); inbound calls never come through this tool.
tool wechat_call.action | string, required, values status|dial|hangup|conference_start|invite | Which call action to perform.
tool wechat_call.callId | string | Call id (hangup, invite); omit for hangup to end the current call.
tool wechat_call.contactId | string | Contact id to call (dial). Must be listed in calls.voice.outboundAllowTo.
tool wechat_call.contactIds | array | Contact ids to invite (conference_start invitees, invite members).
tool wechat_call.groupId | string | Group chat id ending with @chatroom (conference_start).
tool wechat_contact_request | owner DM only | Owner friend-request inbox: list/get requests, send a request, accept one, delete local history of one, or poll a submitted operation. Owner only; every mutation requires an idempotency key and accept/delete need the request version.
tool wechat_contact_request.action | string, required, values list|get|send|accept|delete|status | Which contact-request operation to run.
tool wechat_contact_request.cursor | string | Opaque page cursor from a previous list call.
tool wechat_contact_request.expectedVersion | string | Request version read before mutating.
tool wechat_contact_request.greeting | string | Message sent with the request (send).
tool wechat_contact_request.idempotencyKey | string | Required for accept/delete; also dedupes send.
tool wechat_contact_request.limit | integer, min 1, max 200 | How many requests to return.
tool wechat_contact_request.operationId | string | Operation id (status).
tool wechat_contact_request.recipientRef | string | Who to add (send).
tool wechat_contact_request.requestId | string | Contact-request id to inspect.
tool wechat_contacts | owner DM only | Owner address book: list, get, filter, exact-lookup or search contacts, and remove a contact (keeps chat history). Owner only; removal requires an idempotency key.
tool wechat_contacts.action | string, required, values list|get|find|lookup|search|remove | Which contact operation to run.
tool wechat_contacts.cursor | string | Opaque page cursor from a previous list call.
tool wechat_contacts.idempotencyKey | string | Required for remove.
tool wechat_contacts.limit | integer, min 1, max 200 | How many entries to return.
tool wechat_contacts.query | string | Filter or search text (find/search).
tool wechat_contacts.username | string | Contact wxid.
tool wechat_group_info | owner DM only | Owner view of one WeChat group: metadata plus a member page. Read-only; a remaining nextCursor means the member list is incomplete (absence from one page is not proof a member is gone).
tool wechat_group_info.cursor | string | Opaque member-page cursor from a previous call.
tool wechat_group_info.groupId | string, required | Group chat id, ending with @chatroom.
tool wechat_group_info.limit | integer, min 1, max 100 | How many members to return.
tool wechat_group_info.username | string | Optional member filter.
tool wechat_history | enabled by default | Earlier messages in the current WeChat chat, newest first. Read-only local history; does not fetch remote history or mark the chat read.
tool wechat_history.cursor | string | Opaque page cursor from a previous call.
tool wechat_history.limit | integer, min 1, max 50, default 20 | How many messages to return.
tool wechat_login | owner DM only | Inspect and change this WeChat account login state: list accounts, start a login, wait for a login operation, disconnect locally, log out, or forget stored credentials (requires confirm). Owner only; never fabricates QR codes or success.
tool wechat_login.action | string, required, values status|start|wait|disconnect|logout|forget | Which login operation to run.
tool wechat_login.confirm | boolean | Must be exactly true for forget.
tool wechat_login.force | boolean | Force a fresh login even if one exists (start).
tool wechat_login.operationId | string | Login operation id (wait).
tool wechat_login.timeoutMs | integer, min 1000, max 300000 | How long to wait for the operation (wait, default 30000).
tool wechat_media | enabled by default | Download an attachment from a message in the current WeChat chat. Images are also returned as model-visible image content; files, voice and video are staged for the agent. Pending downloads are reported as pending and can be retried.
tool wechat_media.assetId | string | Specific attachment id; omit to use the message attachments.
tool wechat_media.messageId | string, required, min length 1 | Stored message ID.
tool wechat_message | enabled by default | Read one message by its stored message ID from the current WeChat chat. Read-only; rejects IDs from other chats.
tool wechat_message.messageId | string, required, min length 1 | Stored message ID.
tool wechat_push | opt-in via push config | Send a one-way notification message to a pre-configured WeChat contact or group from any session. Targets are limited to the configured push whitelist; use action "list" to see it. Fire-and-forget: this is not a chat reply and does not create a conversation.
tool wechat_push.action | string, values send|list, default send | send delivers text to one configured target; list returns the configured targets.
tool wechat_push.target | string | Configured target id: a wxid for a direct message or a group id ending with @chatroom. Required for send.
tool wechat_push.text | string, min length 1 | Message text delivered verbatim (whitespace-trimmed). Required for send.
tool wechat_recall | enabled by default | Recall (unsend) a message this account sent in the current WeChat chat. Requires the stored message ID and its server ID; refuses messages that are not your own in this chat.
tool wechat_recall.messageId | string, required, min length 1 | Stored message ID.
tool wechat_recall.serverId | string, required, min length 1 | WeChat's message server ID.
tool wechat_search | enabled by default | Search locally stored messages in the current WeChat chat for text. Read-only; never searches other chats or fetches remote history.
tool wechat_search.cursor | string | Opaque page cursor from a previous call.
tool wechat_search.limit | integer, min 1, max 50, default 20 | How many matches to return.
tool wechat_search.query | string, required, min length 1 | Text to look for.
tool wechat_send_share | enabled by default | Send a link card (title, URL, optional description and thumbnail) to the current WeChat chat. Requires an explicit idempotency key; an accepted send is not proof of delivery.
tool wechat_send_share.description | string | Share card body text.
tool wechat_send_share.idempotencyKey | string, required, min length 1 | Stable key; a retry with the same key never sends twice.
tool wechat_send_share.thumbnailUrl | string | http(s) preview image address.
tool wechat_send_share.title | string, required, min length 1 | Share card title.
tool wechat_send_share.url | string, required, min length 1 | http(s) address the card opens.
tool wechat_stickers | owner DM only | Manage this WeChat account sticker library: list packs and custom stickers, prepare images or videos into stickers, add/move/remove custom stickers. Owner only; mutations require an idempotency key and report submitted jobs, not finished results.
tool wechat_stickers.action | string, required, values list|get|download|prepare|add|move|remove|preview | Which sticker operation to run.
tool wechat_stickers.afterId | string | Move after this sticker; null moves to first.
tool wechat_stickers.durationMs | integer, min 1 | Clip duration in ms (prepare).
tool wechat_stickers.file | string | Path or ref of the source media (prepare).
tool wechat_stickers.fps | integer, min 1 | Frames per second (prepare).
tool wechat_stickers.idempotencyKey | string | Stable key for mutations; a retried call never mutates twice.
tool wechat_stickers.maxEdge | integer, min 1 | Max edge in px (prepare).
tool wechat_stickers.messageId | string | Message carrying the source media (add).
tool wechat_stickers.packId | string | Sticker pack id (future pack actions).
tool wechat_stickers.preparationId | string | Prepared-media job id (add).
tool wechat_stickers.revision | string | List revision for move/remove.
tool wechat_stickers.startMs | integer, min 0 | Clip start in ms (prepare).
tool wechat_stickers.stickerId | string | Custom sticker id (get/download/move/remove).
